regions.merged_text: And many thanks for favor of Nov. 24th Please God - . Philip's arm will be all okay. I am so pleased that you find things so favorable over there. Thank God. Hope it con- tinues so God's blessing for the holy season so near. I am mailing picture as requested. God bless you all.
